notes: strain_points are cumulative linear strain relative to the first point

materials.source_notes: 19.4e-6/K mean CTE and 154 W/(m K) conductivity at 20 C; 20-200 C endpoint supplemented by NIST/AA data.
materials.uncertainty_note: Temperature-dependent values above 200 C are endpoint extrapolation; exact piston temper and casting/forging form are not specified.

materials.source: NIST Properties of Wrought Aluminum and Aluminum Alloys; Aluminium Bozen 2618A datasheet
materials.source_notes: NIST gives mean CTE 22.3, 23.2, 24.1e-6/K over the listed ranges; Aluminium Bozen gives 147 W/(m K) at 20 C.
materials.uncertainty_note: Profile uses mean-CTE ranges converted to cumulative strain; high-temperature property and temper scatter are not measured here.

materials.source: Clinton Aluminum / Aluminum Association typical data
materials.source_notes: 23.6e-6/K mean CTE over 20-100 C, 25.2e-6/K estimated over 20-300 C, and 167 W/(m K) conductivity at 20 C.
materials.uncertainty_note: 20-300 C CTE is identified by the supplier as estimated; an aluminum liner also raises wear, galling and surface-finish questions outside this CTE model.

materials.source_notes: 12.1e-6/K mean CTE over 20-100 C, 13.6e-6/K over 20-400 C, and 42.6 W/(m K) conductivity at 20 C.
materials.uncertainty_note: CTE and conductivity vary with heat treatment, alloy and temperature; this is a representative steel screen, not a procurement specification.

materials.source: Grey cast iron EN 1561 property sheet
materials.source_notes: 11.7e-6/K mean CTE over 20-200 C and 13.0e-6/K over 20-400 C; conductivity is grade-dependent (representative 48.5 W/(m K) at 100 C for GJL-250 range).
materials.uncertainty_note: Graphite morphology and grade materially affect conductivity and expansion; the source table is a grade range, not a certified liner batch.

materials.designation: Silicon nitride SN201B (ceramic piston screening proxy)
materials.source_notes: 2.4e-6/K mean CTE over 40-400 C, 3.2e-6/K over 40-800 C, and 25 W/(m K) conductivity.
materials.uncertainty_note: Ceramic grade, porosity, surface finish, impact tolerance and tribology dominate feasibility questions not represented by scalar CTE.
